E-Way Bill Statistics by State (2018–2026)

Source: R/data.R
ewb_data.Rd

Monthly state-wise e-Way Bill generation statistics for intrastate and interstate movement of goods. Covers FY 2018-19 through FY 2025-26. Assessable values in Rs. Crore.

ewb_data

Format

A data.table with 3,474 rows and 15 columns:

financial_year

character. Financial year.

state_code

character. GST state code.

state

character. State/UT name.

month

character. Month in "YYYY-MM".

month_date

Date. First day of the month.

region

character. Geographic region.

intrastate_suppliers

numeric. Suppliers generating intrastate EWBs.

intrastate_ewb_count

numeric. Number of intrastate e-Way Bills.

intrastate_assessable_value

numeric. Intrastate goods value (Rs. Crore).

interstate_out_suppliers

numeric. Suppliers for outgoing interstate EWBs.

interstate_out_ewb_count

numeric. Outgoing interstate EWB count.

interstate_out_assessable_value

numeric. Outgoing interstate value (Rs. Crore).

interstate_in_suppliers

numeric. Suppliers for incoming interstate EWBs.

interstate_in_ewb_count

numeric. Incoming interstate EWB count.

interstate_in_assessable_value

numeric. Incoming interstate value (Rs. Crore).

Source

National Informatics Centre / GST Council. https://ewaybillgst.gov.in

Examples

data(ewb_data)
# Total EWBs by state in FY 2023-24
ewb_data[financial_year == "2023-24",
         .(total_ewb = sum(intrastate_ewb_count + interstate_out_ewb_count, na.rm = TRUE)),
         by = state][order(-total_ewb)]
